_doc: Reviewed term-gloss decisions (SESSION 39, Luneth-approved). Single source of truth for the term-gloss standard (memory: term-gloss-standard). Enforced by invariants.py::check_claim_text_term_gloss. defects = garbled/obsolete forms that must NEVER appear in front-facing claim_text OR verbatim (blatant book defects, fixed everywhere per Luneth). common_swaps = obscure common name -> simpler, more-recognizable common name, applied to claim_text ONLY; the sacred verbatim keeps Wallach's own common name (only defects are fixed there); an entry may also add a plain gloss to a bare/obscure scientific genus. abbrev_require_explained = genuinely obscure abbreviations that MUST be spelled out somewhere in the same claim_text (any listed trigger phrase present, case-insensitive); universally-grasped acronyms (DNA/RNA/AIDS/HIV/CPR/UV/IQ/MS/PMS/ADD/ADHD/USDA/FDA/MSG/SIDS/EFA/RDA) are intentionally NOT enforced -- a layperson understands them immediately and over-parenthesizing dense summaries hurts readability (Luneth).
